profile.parent: Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. (Tokyo: 1911), held through Sumitomo Forestry America, Inc.

regions.name: Dallas-Fort Worth
regions.geography: Single market run from the Southlake office: 43 cities across the DFW metroplex, from Celina, Anna and Sanger in the north to Waxahachie, Cleburne and Granbury in the south

profile.org_note: Single-market builder run from one Southlake office, with no regions or divisions. The legal entity is a Texas limited partnership whose general partner is Bloomfield Properties, Inc. The 2026 state filing lists co-founder Donald J. Dykstra as chairman and Timothy M. Stewart as president; the other directors are Deborah Dykstra and four Sumitomo Forestry people working from Sumitomo Forestry America's Addison, TX office. Bloomfield buys land and develops its own lots; the only land-side signatory found in public records is vice president Clint Vincent. No CFO, treasurer or land-acquisition head is named publicly, so the founders and the Sumitomo Forestry America board members are the finance decision-makers on record.
profile.summary: Dallas-Fort Worth-only builder founded in 2004, selling its Classic and Elements series in about 65 communities across 43 DFW cities; the company says it has built more than 20,000 homes and describes itself as a major land purchaser and developer. Sumitomo Forestry (Tokyo: 1911) bought 50% in 2013 and raised its stake to 65% in 2017, making Bloomfield a consolidated subsidiary held through Sumitomo Forestry America; the two minority holders named in 2017 (P. Ryan Properties, Inc. and TKJT, Inc.) were still listed as controlling parties, alongside the Dykstras and Tim Stewart, in a December 2024 state disclosure, and the founders still run the business. Since May 2026 it sits alongside DRB Group, Edge Homes, MainVue Homes and Tri Pointe Homes in Sumitomo Forestry's US homebuilding group, so parent capital is the visible funding source.

gaps: CFO / head of finance: not publicly disclosed. No finance officer appears on the company site, in the 2026 state filings or in the municipal documents opened.
Treasurer / capital markets: not publicly disclosed. Bloomfield has no public debt; funding decisions sit with the founders and Sumitomo Forestry America.

Head of land acquisition: not publicly disclosed. The company site says it is a major land purchaser and developer but names no one; Clint Vincent (vice president) is the only land-side signatory found, in a November 2024 city agreement.
Clint Vincent: no 2025 or 2026 document confirming he is still vice president; his functional title (land development) is inferred.

VP of Sales: the role exists (company site footer publishes 'VP, Sales: 972-877-1508') but the name is not published. Names seen in a search-result summary of an AI-generated directory page (highperformr.ai) were not used: that page gives a wrong headquarters, a Houston division that Bloomfield's own site does not show, and text about an unrelated company.
Heads of construction, purchasing and marketing: not publicly disclosed.
Division or regional presidents: none. Bloomfield builds only in Dallas-Fort Worth and has no divisional structure on its site or in filings.

Current Sumitomo Forestry ownership percentage: last disclosed as 65% (April 2017 notice). No later change was found, but Sumitomo Forestry's Integrated Report 2026 does not state the percentage. The remaining interest was held by P. Ryan Properties, Inc. and TKJT, Inc. in 2017, and both were still listed as controlling parties in December 2024; who owns those two entities is not stated in the documents opened.
CEO title: Builder's firm profile reportedly lists Don Dykstra as CEO (page returned 403, not opened); the 2026 state filing shows Chairman for Dykstra and President for Stewart and no CEO.

General-partner board: the 2026 state record for Bloomfield Properties, Inc. also lists Fumihide Nakatsu and Yusuke Watanabe as directors (Addison, TX). They were left out of the people list because that record appears stale: Sumitomo Forestry's November 2024 notice moved Watanabe to a head-office post in Japan from January 2025.
Email pattern: not public. The only published address is opportunities@bloomfieldhomes.net (careers), which shows the mail domain but not a personal-address pattern.
Direct phone numbers for executives: not published; only the corporate line 817-416-1572 and the sales line 817-809-8240.
